observations: Head UV no longer includes the lower torso collar, and back-hair UV excludes the cape shoulder cap.
Body core is armless and drawn once; shoulder armor comes from upper-arm sprites, not duplicate shoulder overlays.
Separate near/far limbs and primary/support hands are assembled in the side camera.
Stock is positioned at the shoulder pocket with IK hands; head and weapon height were adjusted using the assembled view.
Selected walking phases show both knees facing the travel direction, with boots seated on or lifted from the floor.
Left view was inspected with visible bones and stock/hand sockets. It mirrors the same art.
At 500px viewport width, the actor, weapon and main controls fit; the remaining page scrolls.
limitations: No assertion that full-cycle walking is natural or artistically accepted. User review pending.
Static frames do not verify pointer/keyboard interactions or animation timing visually.
Torso/waist/skirt form one outfit set; individual armor slot replacement pending.
Finger poses are painted and fixed; detailed reload finger/bolt motion is not finished.
Mirroring does not render the true opposite equipment side.
Cape and hair use small mesh deformations; torso armor remains rigid.
browser_tool_failure: In-app browser bootstrap failed: missing sandboxPolicy. Local Chrome screenshot CLI used instead. Initial concurrent short-budget captures were unreliable; final affected captures were repeated serially and inspected.
ui_history_note: The exact UI used for the selected captures is archived. A separate concurrent Plan B change subsequently extended the live index.html/app.js; those edits are preserved. The recorded character animation sources are unchanged.

integration_recheck.inspection: Actual shared app loaded and rendered the rig after the concurrent Plan B UI extension. Screenshot visually inspected; no Plan B output acceptance claimed.
